title: HTML Explained in 60 Seconds | HTML for Beginners
description:
Learn HTML basics in 60 seconds! See how tags turn code into a web page, with simple examples of headings, paragraphs, and links.

You’ll learn:
• What HTML means
• Opening and closing tags
• Headings and paragraphs
• Links and the href attribute
• How HTML, CSS, and JavaScript work together

Try it: write a heading and paragraph, save your file as index.html, and open it in your browser.

What will your first web page be about? Tell us in the comments.
Like, share, and subscribe for more beginner web development lessons.
